explication: Matrix-Game is a three-generation family of interactive world models that generates video conditioned on images/prompts and player controls. The graph follows the sampled Matrix-Game-2 image-conditioned and streaming paths, then the Matrix-Game-3 generation and asynchronous VAE decode path; Matrix-Game-1 inference and its scoring capabilities remain represented as a distinct branch. Several relationships and capabilities come from README or SOURCE INDEX references rather than complete excerpts, so uncertain links are omitted.
